Temple care filter
The Temple opens on heroes who need treatment. Show all heroes remains available, with care and fallen counts.
Clear treatment availability
Healthy heroes show Health full or No ailments; insufficient funds show the gold shortfall. Shared buttons replace faded custom controls.
Accessible treatment feedback
Treatment messages announce updates and have a 44-pixel dismiss target. Revival still requires confirmation.
Full trainee names
Training hero names wrap instead of truncating. Selected trainees expose their selected state to assistive technology.
Readable locked training
Locked programs keep readable descriptions and costs, with explicit level requirements and disabled state.
Lighter training projections
Level, XP, readiness and cost use open columns with dividers; program rewards lose their individual box borders.
Training typography
Small training labels are raised to 11 pixels, supporting type is lighter, and the introduction is shorter.
Workshop navigation
Workshop tabs and recipe filters use softer backgrounds and gold underlines, with selected-state accessibility. Summary totals are unboxed.
Material source rows
Material rows use larger touch targets, descriptive accessible labels and a simple warning rail for missing materials.
Recipe readability
Unavailable recipe and enchantment details retain full contrast. Redundant undiscovered badges no longer squeeze recipe titles.
